We read every public page - the pricing notes, the restriction lists, the support claims and the disclosures - and scored the platform on ease of use, features, transparency, security and support. The verdict below is our own.
whatItClaims: 10 crypto assets through broker partners.
A free demo account with practice funds.
Around-the-clock support through the partner desk.
Signals generated without manual chart reading.
A US$250 minimum deposit to start.
whatWeChecked: The support channels: live chat, email or phone availability.
The fine print: clauses that qualify the headline promises.
The fee framing: no platform fees, but spreads embedded in every trade.
The support story: around-the-clock coverage claimed, exact figures conflicting.
The geo-restrictions: two lists on the page that do not agree.
The template marks: unfilled placeholders left in the wording.

steps.title: Register
steps.text: Enter your name, email, phone and country, then confirm through the emailed link.

steps.title: Fund
steps.text: Deposit the US$250 minimum by bank card, bank transfer, PayPal or Skrill.

steps.title: Configure
steps.text: Adjust the risk controls, pick a mode and practise on the demo before going live.

pros: No platform fees on top of spreads.
Risk settings before the first trade.
A browser dashboard - nothing to install.
cons: Registration details not stated up front.
The demo claim buried in the signup flow.
Performance examples without dates or proof.
redFlags: The fee that is not a fee: spreads embedded in every trade.
Restriction lists that name different countries.
Payout promises with no processing detail.

faqs.q: What happens after I sign up?
faqs.a: You confirm the account by email, fund US$250, set your risk preferences and choose automatic or manual mode. The demo account runs alongside while you learn.

faqs.q: Is wobimaxa safe, legit or a scam?
faqs.a: We found no scam indicators in the product, which reads as a functioning AI trading service. The conditions are editorial: claims without verification, conflicting figures and restriction lists that disagree. We rate it safe to research with the conditions in this review.
Yes - the platform offers automatic and manual modes, so you can follow the signals or confirm each entry yourself.

faqs.q: How much support does it offer?
faqs.a: Unclear - around-the-clock coverage is claimed, while other sections quote different figures. Ask support to reconcile them before you fund anything.
The lists conflict - different sections of the site name different countries. Confirm your eligibility with support before depositing.

bottomLine: The service behind the marketing looks functional, and a careful user can use it without stepping on the fine print.
The final score lands at 4.5 - a capable platform held back by its own paperwork. Start small, verify the claims yourself and never trade money you cannot lose.
